results.transparencyNote: Relevance is computed deterministically from verified portfolio records, tags, and technical keywords — never from an arbitrary percentage score or external AI.
results.customRoleNotice: Custom position "{{role}}" is used strictly to prioritize the closest verified records in this portfolio. It does not represent an unverified title or claim.
results.insufficientMatchNotice: No direct keyword overlap was found for this custom role in the current portfolio records. Displaying verified engineering records ordered by core priority.
